english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for something funny or intentionally comic.
This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for something or someone funny and likely to make people laugh.
Use 搞笑 when entertaining mainly means funny or likely to make people laugh.
Use this when playful means funny, joking, or deliberately amusing rather than fond of games.
Use this as the everyday choice for someone or something intentionally funny and entertaining.
Choose this when the emphasis is on being funny or clownish rather than simply strange.
Use this when something is absurd or ridiculous in an amusing or sarcastic way, as in “That’s priceless.”
Use this for a joke or other thing that is funny and makes people laugh.
